boundary_review: Workflow runs ordinary push/PR/explicit dispatch, full verified official Action SHAs, contents:read only, no retained checkout credentials, secrets or release/attestation steps.

PS7 driver starts with PSModulePath removed in transient outer shell; tier/static subprocess receives blank child PSModulePath to let selected shell reconstruct compatible defaults; no persistent policy/path/module installation mutation.

Dependency bootstrap is explicitly hosted-Windows gated, uses unique owned RUNNER_TEMP roots, verifies known archive length/SHA256 before extraction or execution, rejects unsafe ZIP/native-list paths and reparse points, and verifies selected native/module files.

PDFtk and GS installers are read as data; extractor is direct ProcessStartInfo without shell evaluation, bounded waiting and drained output. Hosted preinstalled full7z is recorded separately with actual file version/hash.
Mock/controlled and real native jobs/tier evidence remain separate; hosted Server/admin runner limitations and manual_desktop_acceptance:false are explicit.

Exporter requires guarded source/host/count JSON and matching NUnit roots/cases before rewriting public XML. It strips raw identities, paths, descriptions, diagnostics and extra attributes; JSON uses generated allowed fields only; XML external entities are prohibited.

Child nonzero exit, failed/skipped/unrun/empty/discovery/changed-source counts, missing/invalid receipt or artifact upload failure cannot turn into job pass. Deliberate failing probe remains a failed receipt/nonzero driver result.
Native acquisition optional analyzer and workflow empty-argument boundaries corrected; no remaining source blocker found in final reviewed bytes.

supplemental_receipt_check.command: Dot-source tools/test/CiReportSupport.ps1; invoke Export-CiTestReport over Unit, Static, Launcher, NativeRunner, ToolInvocation, PublicDocs, NativeFixture, SourceDiscovery, PdftkPaths and GhostscriptPaths for both T23 PS51 and PS7 report pairs using their recorded commit/shell; scan generated public XML for repository/user/machine/path/raw environment markers.
supplemental_receipt_check.scope: Existing T23 source-bound sanitized raw report compatibility/export only; no rerun, no CI/application/native acceptance claim

limitations: Source/design review and export of existing T23 receipts are neither a new application/native execution nor GitHub CI acceptance.
Actual successful workflow jobs, artifacts and deliberate failure workflow evidence at committed intended sources remain mandatory AC054 work for the parent.
No claim that GitHub hosted Server/admin evidence closes standard-user/desktop/Explorer/package/publication gates.
No tracked files changed by this reviewer; ignored review/oracle artifacts only.
